settings.text:
What if you had total confidence to follow your heart, and it worked, every single time?

What if you could discern your feelings and thoughts from the feelings and thoughts of others, and gain control over your empathic reactions?

What if you could get an accurate reading on any situation, to find the best course of action at any given moment?

Your intuition has only one goal:
to make you happy.

It has your very best interests at heart.

It is your best friend because it is your true self in action.
Learn how to use inner resonance to sharpen your intuition, reading yourself, other people and your environment with astonishing accuracy and decisive confidence.

When you develop your intuition you’ll realize who you are, own it, and apply that authenticity and a sharp eye for discernment in every area of their life. You’ll stop hesitating to make decisions, so you attract changes 10x faster. You start making good decisions. You come to realize that you are not crazy or deluded, that in fact, you have incredible abilities of perception, and are perceiving correctly. You stop mistaking other peoples’ negative energy for your own. You develop the inner knowledge to process tough emotions and eliminate dissonance you may have endured your entire life, and you’ll help people, in a sustainable, energizing way that feeds you joy!

- Yolessa K. Lawrinnce, 17+ Years as a professional Psychic-Medium and lawyer.

If you've been thinking about changing your life, then you need to arm yourself with the power inherent in this course. Nearly all my students come to a significant transition in their life path when I meet them. This is no accident. The energy and spiritual guidance given during the course provides tremendous support to move the needle. The Intuitive Development Course and Reader Certification is a landmark course. It is an important course designed to develop intuition quickly and powerfully.

A lot of people think that famous singers are born with immaculate voices. I found out at 25 years old that was a lie. They work hard at it. Their voices are instruments, and they spent a lot of energy from a very young age to tune it. That's why they are amazing. Intuition is no different. The perception is that you just have it, but that's just not true, it’s developed, when encouraged, from birth.
Consistent clarity, discernment, powerful decision-making skills, trust and wisdom are the result of developing your intuitive inner knowledge.

We are being inundated with information 24/7 from electronic devices, our relationship with people and their moods and changes, from books, institutions, you name it. All of this information is energy that is consistently drawing your attention, your focus, your energy, many times without you even being conscious of what is happening to you.

On a daily basis you may be subjected to an emotional rollercoaster and left wondering what’s wrong with you, why you lack energy, why you are so prone to moods. You are trying to process an overwhelm of information.

Becoming skilled with your intuition is less about predicting the future, though it helps, and more about training your focus, and gaining the power to know what’s what. To know what feelings truly belong to you and what you are picking up from your environment. With this super power you no longer burden yourself with attempting to process other people’s stuff, becoming powerfully connected to yourself, your impulses and desires will act as a GPS to guide you in fulfilling your purpose in the best way possible.

In the Intuitive Reader Certification Course you will truly master your Clairsenses, your 6th sense and beyond. The culmination of this course is total confidence in your ability to discern energy, information and be grounded in your True Self. You will actually practice reading others and be validated in your abilities, and would be qualified to be promoted as a reader for Sedona Healing Arts.

Your intuition is part of your human design, and is the KEY to freedom, abundance, peace, love, and fulfillment. If you are cut off from your intuition, it is impossible to be happy. I’m not kidding. That’s because your intuition aims to satisfy the heart and soul, and if you live against it, well, enough said.

settings.text:
Yulyeosa is a psychic-medium, healer and director and trainer at Sedona Healing Arts, a center for spiritual awakening. She has over 17 years of experience, has guided more than 10,000 people on their healing journey through readings and training programs, and is featured in “Love Heals” and “Going Om” documentaries featured on Gaia.

She is committed to raising consciousness on the planet. She pours her heart into helping people become free, know their value, express it, and know unconditional love for themselves and the sake of humanity.  Utilizing her exceptional abilities (clairsentience, clairvoyance and clairaudience), she pinpoints the core source of depleting beliefs and self-sabotaging patterns giving people the ability to free themselves to live authentically.  Her wisdom and deep understanding of the universal laws and principles are at the core of her training programs that activate innate psychic & intuitive abilities for self-empowerment.  

She is a Tao Master and a lawyer.

settings.text: We believe we’ve created the world’s best intuitive development program. Combining principle with practice, secret and ancient sensitization techniques, we know you will come through transformed.
10+ modules devoted to energetic development that open and stabilize your Spiritual Gifts - audio and visual recordings available.
Complete 19+ exercises and meditations that activate your core energy centers.
Complete each module in your own time - average 6 hours per module.
Complete homework at the end of each lesson reviewed by your instructor.
Attend 30 minute 1 on 1 check ins with your instructor via zoom monthly to help you progress.
Additional support resources like a physical workbook, transcripts, and practicals.
2 Hour Live Practicum dedicated to your first live intuitive readings.
Complete 40 30-minute live readings curated by your mentor.
2 Interim Sessions at the 20 reading mark and upon completion to ensure you understand your reading process and progress in ability.
Revisit the program with lifetime access & support - including access to new content bonuses, and opportunities to receive readings and healings by students in progress.

In reality, babies are confident. Confidence is inborn, and then slowly eroded by difficult life experiences. My students realize who they are, own it, and apply that authenticity and a sharp eye for discernment in every area of their life. They stop hesitating to make decisions, so they manifest 100x faster. They start making good decisions. They come to realize that they are not crazy or deluded, that in fact, they have incredible abilities of perception, and are perceiving energy correctly. They stop mistaking other peoples’ negative energy for their own. They develop the energetic ability to process tough emotions and move on from stuckness they may have endured their whole life, and THEY HELP PEOPLE, in a sustainable, energizing way that feeds them joy!

Your intuition is part of your human design, and is the KEY to freedom, abundance, peace, love, and fulfillment. If you are cut off from your intuition, it is impossible to by happy. I’m not kidding. That’s because your intuition aims to satisfy the heart and soul, and if you live against it, well, enough said.
